candidates.description: This vector represents multilingual fragments, surface textures, and geographical articles associated with winter sports and aquatic environments.
This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and fragments of Hindi text.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing common Hindi subword suffixes or word fragments ending in dental/retroflex consonants.
The tokens represent variations and components of the Hindi syllable "भ" (bha) and related conjuncts or words.
These tokens represent common sub-word suffixes, morphs, and character combinations in the Hindi Devanagari script.
These tokens represent the Devanagari retroflex stop consonant 'ṭa' (ट) and its various vowel and conjunct modifications.
These tokens represent common Hindi function words, pronouns, and modifiers.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel characters and common word prefixes.
This vector activates on common subwords, consonant clusters, and functional words in the Hindi Devanagari script.
This vector activates strongly on common Hindi consonant-vowel matra combinations and word suffixes.
